notes.nhead: Number of attention heads (must divide d_model)
notes.n_bins: Number of expression bins (for binned mode)
notes.max_seq_len: Maximum sequence length (1000 genes + CLS token)
notes.use_positional_encoding: Whether to add positional encoding (often not needed for gene expression)
notes.norm_first: Use pre-LN (true) or post-LN (false). Pre-LN is more stable
notes.explicit_zero_prob: Model zero expression separately (useful for sparse data)
